table1.title: Table I -- Aggregate Totals by Jurisdiction
table1.description: The primary CbCR table. Reports jurisdiction-level aggregates and distributional percentiles (P5, P25, P50, P75, P95) for all financial and activity-share variables, cross-tabulated by parent jurisdiction (REF\_AREA) and affiliate jurisdiction (COUNTERPART\_AREA). Covers fiscal years 2016--2022.

PANELAII.label: Panel A-II: all MNEs including loss-making

_T.label: All MNEs (Panel A-I and A-II combined)

table2.title: Table II -- Interquartile Means by Jurisdiction
table2.description: Reports the interquartile mean (IQM) of financial variables -- the mean calculated after excluding the bottom and top quartile of MNE groups. Provides a robust central-tendency measure less sensitive to outlier MNEs. Activity-share measures (ACT\_*) are excluded. Covers fiscal years 2017--2022.

IQMEAN.label: Interquartile mean (mean excluding bottom and top quartile)

PANELAII.label: Panel A-II: all MNEs including loss-making

_T.label: All MNEs (Panel A-I and A-II combined)

table3.title: Table III -- Entity Counts by ETR Bracket (MNE Level)
table3.description: Reports the count of constituent entities and activity-share distributions by effective tax rate bracket, aggregated at the MNE-group level (TRMNE). This table captures how many entities are active in each ETR range, broken down by activity type. Financial totals (profit, assets, etc.) are not available in this table. Covers fiscal years 2017--2022.

TRMNE.label: Aggregated by MNE group, categorised by reporting jurisdiction

NEGATIVE_PROFIT_TAX_ACCRUED.label: Negative profit AND negative tax accrued

table4.title: Table IV -- Aggregate Totals by ETR Bracket (Subsidiary Level)
table4.description: The most policy-relevant ETR breakdown. Reports all financial aggregates and activity-share variables disaggregated by eleven ETR brackets, at the subsidiary (TRSUB) level. Critical for GMT revenue simulation: allows direct computation of the volume of profit, assets, payroll and tax accrued below the 15\%\@ threshold. Covers fiscal years 2016--2022.

table5.title: Table V -- MNE Group Size Distribution
table5.description: Reports percentile distributions (P5, P10, P25, P50, P75, P90, P95) of MNE group size, measured by consolidated unrelated-party revenue (UPR), total assets and employment, by parent jurisdiction. Does not contain a COUNTERPART\_AREA dimension. Covers fiscal years 2016--2022.

TRMNE.label: Aggregated by MNE group, categorised by reporting jurisdiction

table6.title: Table VI -- Aggregate Totals by MNE Group Size Class
table6.description: Reports all financial and activity-share variables disaggregated by five consolidated revenue size classes of MNE groups. Allows analysis of how tax behaviour varies across the size spectrum -- particularly relevant for understanding the EUR~750~million revenue threshold behaviour. Currently covers fiscal year 2022 only.

MNESIZE.label: Disaggregated by MNE group consolidated revenue size class
